terminal_model_only.description: Frozen Terminal v2 four-query confirmation; A0 is not required.

a0_hard_required_with_terminal.description: Terminal v2 confirmation and strong repeated A0 observation are both required.

legacy_a0_sufficient_fallback.description: Repeated VLM STOP plus repeated legacy-threshold A0 confirmation.

strong_a0_sufficient_fallback.description: Repeated VLM STOP plus repeated A0 observations at confidence >=0.60.

conditional_hierarchical.description: Fresh trusted raw route-near confirmation may accept without A0; blind fallback requires repeated strong A0 plus VLM STOP; trusted-far evidence vetoes.
